subject: Team compact review + proposed redistribution and confidential coaching
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning on Q4 reassignment + sensitive coaching plan

Team —

Quick note ahead of the 1:1s this week. I want to surface a possible redistribution of a couple of small feature owners on the data-reliability squad so we can free up bandwidth for the infra migration in Q1. There is one direct report (E--, not included here) who’s been in the low end of their milestone delivery and we've started an informal coaching cadence in September.

Before any formal change or sensitive HR steps, I wanted to make sure we align on:
- immediate scope reassignments (2–3 week shadow handoffs)
- how we capture OKR-level expectations in the check-in docs
- who to loop in from People Ops for a confidential coaching plan if needed

I’m attaching a lightweight template for Q4 goals to make the handoff concrete. Please reply with any immediate red flags on roadmap impact.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Engineering Manager, Core Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q4_goals_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Elaine Carter <elaine.carter@peopleops-consult.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning on Q4 reassignment + sensitive coaching plan

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks Mina — good call. High level proposal from my side:
1) Move two small feature owners (auth-telemetry & nightly-import) to the reliability pod for Q4; transition window 2 weeks with overlap.
2) Keep product delivery on track by creating a temporary "focus lane" (Ben, I’d like your quick sign-off on which tickets to prioritize).
3) For the direct report I mentioned — informal coaching has been documented; if coaching doesn't show progress by mid-Dec we should escalate to a formal performance improvement plan.

Marissa — can People Ops take the confidential lead on the coaching materials and next steps? Elaine, I’m looping you as our external consultant so we have a neutral reviewer for the documentation and that we follow best-practice confidentiality.

I attached a draft of coaching notes to give a view of what I’ve been tracking. I can host a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk through the handoffs.

Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Engineering Manager, Edge Team
Redwood Inference

Attachments: coaching_notes_draft.pdf (pdf stub)
Related: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeFGhQ-compact-plan

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning on Q4 reassignment + sensitive coaching plan

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 10:12 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben / Marissa —
> 
> Thanks Mina — good call. High level proposal from my side:
> 1) Move two small feature owners (auth-telemetry & nightly-import) to the reliability pod for Q4; transition window 2 weeks with overlap.
> 
Thanks — this seems sensible. Two quick notes from product: 
- We should preserve the auth-telemetry spike that’s scheduled for 11/22; suggest Ben T. keep the spike owner but have the reliability engineer take on the follow-up tickets.
- Nightly-import ownership can move earlier if we call out the risk in the sprint plan (I’ll add a blocker label and tag the on-call).

I support Aisha looping People Ops on the coaching path. From a roadmap perspective, the temporary handoff will not block the infra migration assuming we protect the two cross-team tickets I flagged in JIRA. I listed them in JIRA-OPS-4821.

I’ve uploaded a brief transition matrix CSV with the proposed ticket owners and timelines.

Ben Carter
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment: transition_matrix.csv (csv stub)
Related link: JIRA-OPS-4821

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Elaine Carter <elaine.carter@peopleops-consult.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning on Q4 reassignment + sensitive coaching plan

Thanks all —

Appreciate the clear plan. People Ops will take the confidential lead on the coaching documentation and will only share formal PIP steps if a manager confirms that coaching milestones were not met. Elaine — can you review the draft coaching_notes_draft.pdf and confirm any language edits for confidentiality/compliance?

Next steps I recommend:
- Aisha and Mina to schedule 30-min sync (confidential) with the direct report this week to align goals using the Q4_goals_template.
- Ben to flag the two JIRA tickets as "protected" during the transition (JIRA-OPS-4821).
- People Ops (Marissa + Elaine) to own the coaching artifacts and keep a sealed copy in the HR case system once (if) we move to formal steps.

I will prepare a private calendar invite (1:1) and will include only Aisha, Mina, and the direct report; I will loop Elaine as silent reviewer where needed. Please confirm availability.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, People & Culture
Redwood Inference

PS — I will not be adding details of the direct report in the group thread; any sensitive notes will be stored in the HR system per our policy.
